shared_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one real photograph teaching a Spanish-speaking beginner the English words THIS (the object in my own hand) and THAT (the identical object a short distance away). Natural everyday photographic detail, real material grain, soft daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark, captions, letters, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, including on objects, screens and clothing. Strict first-person view from the learner's own eyes: exactly two of the learner's own forearms enter from the bottom edge, naturally attached, each hand with five natural fingers, plain charcoal-grey knit sleeves, medium-brown skin, no rings, watches or bracelets. No other people, hands, faces, mirrors or reflections. Exactly TWO identical objects of the requested kind, same model, color and size, and no other object of that kind anywhere. Both objects complete, uncropped, sharp and in focus. A first-time learner must understand the scene instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

assets.prompt:
THAT state. The learner stands at the near end of a long, completely bare light-oak dining table in a bright, plain room with white walls; the camera looks steeply down and along the tabletop. Two identical closed hardcover books with plain deep-green cloth covers and cream page edges; the covers are completely blank, with no title, text, pattern or picture.
NEAR book: the LEFT hand holds it closed by its lower edge, thumb on the cover, about 20 centimeters above the lower-left part of the table. The whole cover and page edges are visible; it spans about one third of the photo width and stays in the lower-left quarter.
FAR book: lies flat on the same tabletop only about 80 centimeters farther away, alone on empty wood in the upper center of the photo. It is clearly smaller, but at least 18 percent of the photo width, sharp and unmistakably the same green book; the near book looks about twice as big.
RIGHT hand: the forearm enters from the lower-right corner and the hand stays in the lower half of the photo. The index finger is fully straight and aimed diagonally up and to the left, exactly at the FAR book; the other fingers are curled with the thumb resting on them. A straight line continued from the fingertip runs into the center of the far book. A wide gap of empty space separates the fingertip from the far book; no hand overlaps, touches or hides either book.
Nothing else on the table: no papers, phones, cups, plates or decorations; no bookshelves anywhere. The picture means: THAT green book over there, while my left hand holds THIS one.
assets.expected_description: same paired scene; left hand keeps holding the near book while right hand points from below at the identical far book without overlapping or touching it

change_control.old_observation: Third-person photo of a woman pointing across a living room; the tiny, pasted-looking book on the far dining table lies off her finger line, so she points at empty space (user report 2026-09-19); no held near book.
